purpose: Preserve every intact V31 donor conditional-rank value and its within-patch structure while replacing global or additive query coupling by a target-free one-to-one local patch correspondence with an exact shuffled-query causal control.

inherited_inputs.selection_rule: reuse every frozen V28/V31 query, donor identity, and donor isometry byte-for-byte

train_only_patch_descriptor.block_grid: 8^3 nonoverlapping blocks, each containing 8^3 native voxels and spanning 2.5 Mpc/h
train_only_patch_descriptor.overlap_context: periodic 3x3x3 neighborhood of all four central fields around every block, yielding 108 ordered components whose neighboring descriptors overlap
train_only_patch_descriptor.normalization: common per-field mean and standard deviation fitted on all train block cells with exactly one-third total weight per TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift source

bijective_assignment.donor_preparation: compute the exact V31 conditional-rank cube, apply the frozen donor isometry to both rank cube and target-free descriptor, and never translate or reselect the donor
bijective_assignment.descriptor_cost: mean squared difference between the 108 standardized overlapping-context components of a query block and donor block
bijective_assignment.spatial_cost: squared periodic block displacement divided by 3*(8/2)^2, bounded by one
bijective_assignment.total_cost: descriptor_cost plus spatial_cost with fixed unit coefficients
bijective_assignment.solver: scipy.optimize.linear_sum_assignment on the frozen 512x512 cost matrix; query block rows receive donor block columns
bijective_assignment.transport: copy each complete 8^3 donor conditional-rank block to its assigned nonoverlapping query block; this exactly preserves the donor rank multiset and all within-block ranks
bijective_assignment.aligned_arm: cost uses the actual query object's descriptor
bijective_assignment.shuffled_query_control: cost uses the next frozen query descriptor cyclically in the same domain but inversion uses the unchanged actual query backbone

development_evaluation.primary_pass: aligned_patch passes field plus Q3 and Q4 independently in every domain
development_evaluation.patch_alignment_material: aligned Q4/V31 <=0.75 and aligned Q4/shuffled <=0.90 in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
patch_alignment_material but Q3 or Q4 still fails

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact parent, V35 data/cache, V31 copula, selection, and reference hashes
source-balanced descriptor fit uses train inputs/backbones only
synthetic and real Hungarian assignments are complete one-to-one permutations
transport preserves the sorted donor conditional-rank values exactly
aligned and shuffled arms use identical donors/isometries and no density truth for assignment
one real sample per arm is finite with residual DC below 1e-7
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
